contracts.name: test_age_contract.py
names: R2.1 the age counts the birthdays had up to and including the day, so it goes up on the birthday itself
R2.2 a person born on 29 February has their birthday on 1 March in a year that is not a leap year
R2.3 a day before the birth date raises AgeError with one plain sentence

contracts.name: test_cli_contract.py
names: R3.1 two YYYY-MM-DD dates print the age as a whole number on a line of its own and exit with code 0
R3.2 a bad date, a day before birth or a wrong number of arguments gives one line on stderr, nothing on stdout, exit code 1
